property_summary: After any call to Collect(uint256), the unlockTime of the caller cannot be less than the block.timestamp at the time of the call.
After Collect, the caller's unlockTime must equal the block timestamp at which the caller's most recent Put set it, which is always >= block.timestamp at that time.
After a call to Collect, the unlockTime of the caller is equal to the unlockTime they set in their most recent Put call.
After Collect, the caller's unlockTime must be at least as large as the unlockTime they specified in their last Put call.
After Collect, the caller's unlockTime is at least as large as the block timestamp at the time of the call.
When the caller has insufficient balance, the Collect function must revert (not proceed to send Ether).
When the caller attempts to collect an amount equal to their balance, the Collect function should not revert (reference allows it, bug disallows it).
When the caller's balance equals the requested withdrawal amount, Collect should succeed without revert.
When the sender's balance equals the withdrawal amount, Collect must not revert and must correctly reduce the balance by that amount.
When a user's balance equals the requested collect amount, Collect should succeed without reverting.
